runs_locally.evidence: attack.py compiles and produced real OpenRouter target runs for DeepSeek Chat and DeepSeek-V4 Flash.

faithful_to_paper.evidence: The paper requires the victim's actual separator token. The current OpenRouter chat-completions path can only send literal template text in a user message, so it does not establish target-side token delivery for DeepSeek V4 Flash. See the unit-root CONSOLIDATE_BLOCKER.md.

self_contained.evidence: Paper-local AdvBench-compatible cache is at data/advbench; no GPU is required.

result_comparable.evidence: The archived results are auditable prompt-rendering experiments, but they cannot be interpreted as Virtual Context attack evidence until a target-specific raw-token route exists.

note: The archived DeepSeek V4 Flash result is retained as a prompt-rendering observation only. It is not a Virtual Context negative result because the selected target's separator token was not delivered through a matching serialization route.
